name: PoliTost Smartbook
direction: Carta: paper objects on a desk. Raised and pressed surfaces, a paper sheet for the text, matte covers with a line drawing per subject, terracotta.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The desk: the ground of every page, the reader header and the space around the sheet.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Paper: the chapter sheet and pop-overs. The lightest step in light, one step above `surface` in dark.

tokens.name: figure-plate
tokens.usage: The plate a chapter figure sits on. Book figures are drawn on white, so the image is multiplied onto the plate: white turns into the plate and the lines keep their colour. Light in both themes, a little dimmer in dark so it does not glare.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised objects on the desk: header bar, book tiles, the resume panel, exercise cards, buttons. Always with a `raised` shadow.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The well: inset areas pressed into the desk, such as the section switcher track, the TOC panel, chips, the import tray and meters. Always with a `pressed` shadow.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, dropdowns and popovers. Always with `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the 1px edge of raised objects. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, dashed drop areas and dividers that carry meaning. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Book text, headings and icons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, TOC paragraphs, inactive tabs. 4.5:1 on every surface and well.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Numbers in lists, metadata, placeholders. 4.5:1 on every surface and well.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (tooltips).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Terracotta: the one primary button per view, checked controls, the progress fill.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta as text: links, cross-references, the active tab, kickers, numbers in badges.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: formula-reference hover, selection.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: The ribbon: the bookmark in the logo, on the cover of the book being read, and the current-paragraph dot. A mark, never text.

tokens.name: star-text
tokens.usage: Hint labels, the medium difficulty, licensed badges. On surfaces and `star-soft`.

tokens.name: star-soft
tokens.usage: Hint block background, licensed badge, search highlight.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Slate blue as text: the imported badge and info notices.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info notices and the imported badge.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Easy difficulty, the solution label, a finished lab run, a valid import. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Solution block background, success notices, the easy difficulty chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Hard errors, failed imports, destructive actions. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error output and failed-import notices.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 3px offset, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the lab editor and formula plates on paper.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the TOC drawer.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Dark half of the raised and pressed shadows. Only used inside shadow tokens.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Light half of the raised and pressed shadows. Only used inside shadow tokens.

tokens.name: pages
tokens.usage: Page edges drawn on the right of a cover.

tokens.name: pages-line
tokens.usage: Lines between the page edges of a cover.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and cross-references in book text.

tokens.name: hint
tokens.usage: The hint label and icon in RevealBlock.

tokens.name: solution
tokens.usage: The solution label and icon in RevealBlock.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First plot series, the function being studied.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second plot series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series and marked points. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Plot gridlines; axes use `border-control`.

covers.name: terracotta
covers.usage: Fisica and every subject without a fixed colour that hashes here.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The resume title on the library. Once per screen; scales down to 38px on phones.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Chapter titles and section titles (Formulario, Esercizi, Laboratorio). 36px on phones.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Paragraph headings, with the number in a raised badge. 26px on phones.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles: book tiles, formula cards, lab cells, exercise ids.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: La velocità media è il rapporto tra lo spazio percorso e il tempo impiegato a percorrerlo.
styles.usage: Chapter text and exercise questions. 18px on phones. Optical size follows the size.

styles.name: reading-small
styles.sample: Ricorda che l'accelerazione è la derivata della velocità.
styles.usage: Hint and solution bodies, formula descriptions, the library introduction.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Importa un file .ptsb per aggiungerlo alla libreria.
styles.usage: Default UI text: forms, TOC chapters, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, the open TOC chapter, emphasised values.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, TOC paragraphs, helper text, captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers and panel titles (In questo capitolo, Indice). Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Numbers as data: formula and exercise numbers, percentages. Tabular figures.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, the lab editor and its output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between small controls, row padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside headers, small control padding-x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on phones, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding-x, space between reading paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between exercise cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between book tiles, space above a sub-heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between paragraphs, top of the library.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space before the pager and between library sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The paper sheet: paper has sharp-ish corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows in lists, inline code, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, formula plates, reveal bodies, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Figures, the pager, the drop area.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Tiles, exercise cards, the TOC panel, the outline, modals.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The resume panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and difficulty tags.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and reveal buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The import call to action.

tokens.name: control-icon
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons in headers.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The reader header.

tokens.name: sider-width
tokens.usage: The TOC panel; 240px below 1240px, a drawer below 1024px.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The outline on the right, from 1360px.

tokens.name: reading-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the paper sheet; the text inside stops at 76ch.

tokens.name: wide-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the library and the wide reader sections.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Large raised objects: the header bar, the resume panel, book tiles, exercise cards, the outline.

tokens.name: raised-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, the active tab, the open TOC chapter, number badges.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: A control while pressed or on, and the section switcher track.

tokens.name: pressed-lg
tokens.usage: Large wells: the TOC panel and the import tray.

tokens.name: pressed-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, difficulty tags and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The paper sheet and the two sheets stacked under it.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, modals and the TOC drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Alias kept for old components: a small raised object.
